text:
The dish looks like a pupusa or a small stuffed flatbread topped with curtido (cabbage slaw). The plate is about 26 cm across and spans roughly 355 px, so 1 cm is about 13.6 px. The flatbread is about 175 px wide, which is roughly 12-13 cm. It is thick, perhaps 1.5-2 cm.

For weight, the flatbread with its filling is probably about 150 g. The slaw on top adds about 40 g, so the total is around 190 g.

For energy, a pupusa of this size with cheese or bean filling comes to about 250-300 kcal. The slaw adds about 20 kcal, and any oil on the surface adds a little more. I estimate about 320 kcal in total.
